focus_areas: Structural connectivity of tail and wings in dynamic pose
Absence/Occlusion of legs in dabbling posture
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition line where the duck meets the water, especially around the raised tail. AI generators often create a 'halo' or soft blur here instead of a sharp displacement of water. Verify that the curl of the tail feathers follows a physically plausible structure and isn't just a textured blob. Specifically check the area under the raised tail for any signs of fused or missing leg structures, as the pose exposes the vent area.
image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) floating on dark, rippling water. The duck is captured in a dynamic pose with its head tucked down towards the water and its tail feathers raised high (dabbling posture). It displays characteristic breeding plumage: an iridescent green head, a distinct white neck ring, and a brownish-grey patterned body. The bill is visible and appears yellow-green. The reflection of the duck is distorted in the water.
